dataFlow.before: When IndexedDB cache (all) or filtered inbound queue (inbounds) was empty, the component queried the legacy, in-memory tripEngineService.getAllTrips() to populate the queues.
dataFlow.after: Component reads strictly from IndexedDB cache and remote Firestore. If the cache is empty, the queue and search source remain empty. No legacy fallback is queried.

emptyStateAcceptance.emptyCanonicalCache: Empty incoming queue and empty search source
emptyStateAcceptance.nonemptyCacheWithZeroIncomingMatches: Incoming queue stays empty, search source remains cached
emptyStateAcceptance.cacheReadFailure: Handled as empty with no legacy fallback queried

projectScopeAndAuthorization.authorization: Preserved. Restricted to scale operators, site supervisors, supervisors, project admins, and super admins.
projectScopeAndAuthorization.projectFiltering: Preserved. Employs tripRepository.listByProject(projectId) to hydrate local cache.

outboxAndFSMPreservation.outboxBehavior: Unchanged. Enqueues status updates and weights atomically into outboxService.
outboxAndFSMPreservation.fsmTransitions: Unchanged. Adheres to IN_TRANSIT -> ARRIVED -> UNLOADING -> COMPLETED sequence.

preExistingIssues.issue: B77-T05 to B77-T12 tests in src/tests/fieldLoadingUnloadingBlock77.test.ts fail due to TRK-9901 truck not being registered in system master data.
preExistingIssues.mitigation: Not modified as per instructions to avoid changing unrelated historical tests.
